# Practice

::: {.lede}
Before returning to academia I worked at the centre of government in Chile, on
legislative strategy and regulatory design.
:::

::: {.marginnote}
**Presidency of Chile**

Chief of the Legal Office

Legal adviser
:::

As Chief of the Legal Office of the Presidency of Chile, I advised on legislative
strategy and regulatory design at the highest level of government, and earlier
served as legal adviser to the same institution.

::: {.marginnote}
**Constitutional Court of Chile**

Law clerk
:::

As a law clerk at the Constitutional Court of Chile, I worked on constitutional
review — experience that continues to inform how I read the relationship between
courts, legislatures, and administration.
